known_limitations: This manifest records immutable raw source files only; processing and split audits are pending.
The random file is an upstream reference and is not a frozen benchmark split.
Raw ingest does not establish activity-bin semantics, label direction, missing-value rules, stable candidate identity, duplicate handling, or hidden-label authorization.
The two-to-many artifact is preserved as an upstream split reference; its membership and leakage controls require a separate Split Manifest.
The NucB task README declares CC-BY-4.0 and first-hand lab provenance; external releases must preserve the FLIP2 DOI and attribution to Thomas et al., bioRxiv 2024.03.21.585615.
